---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement to the watchdog
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**What's the problem?**
Describe the scenario that's not covered today. Real examples help most:
"public hearings for DNV never show up in the digest", "I want to be alerted
when the word 'sewage' appears", etc.

**What should the watchdog do?**
The behaviour you'd like to see.

**Which municipality (if any)?**
- [ ] DNV
- [ ] CNV
- [ ] DWV
- [ ] All / general

**Suggested approach (optional)**
Any ideas about implementation — new keyword, new scraper, new notification
channel, etc.

**Willing to contribute?**
- [ ] I can write the code / submit a PR
- [ ] I can help test
- [ ] Just putting the idea out there
